entry.title: Crypto Super PAC Fairshake Pours Millions More Into Defeating Sherrod Brown
entry.summary: An FEC filing shows the Fairshake affiliate Defend American Jobs disclosed roughly $7 million more in ads against the Ohio Democrat, pushing its total past $46 million—days after the PAC expanded its map to 32 House races.

entry.title: Crypto Firms Launch Quantum Alliance as 6 Million Bitcoin Sit Exposed
entry.summary: The nine-member group, modeled on the Internet Engineering Task Force, aims to set open standards for testing quantum-resistance claims as forecasts place the first practical attack in the late 2020s.

entry.title: Chinese Startup StepFun Launches a Phone Built Around an AI Agent, Not Apps
entry.summary: StepFun's STEPX Neo opened for pre-orders in China on Oct. 13 at 3,999 yuan, with an AI agent built into the operating system instead of bolted on as an app.

entry.title: TokenMaxxing: How to Get the Most Out of Your AI Models
entry.summary: AI companies charge by the token, and most people burn them on jobs a cheap model could do. Here's how to spend less and get better results, from your first prompt to your first agent.

entry.title: Tesla Roadster Rocket Is the Cool 'Flying' Car You Can’t Have
entry.summary: Tesla's new Roadster flips through the air, jumps a row of Teslas and lands on SpaceX thrusters. The Rocket version is invite only, not approved for public roads, and not due until 2028.

entry.title: Hackers Jailbreak iPhone 18 Pro on Stage, and It Survives a Reboot
entry.summary: Calif showed an untethered jailbreak on an iPhone 18 Pro running iOS 27.0.1 at Hexacon in Paris. It survived a reboot, but no tool or bug details are public yet.

entry.title: Circle Plans Push Into 40 Emerging Markets as Stablecoins Go Mainstream, CEO Says
entry.summary: Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire told Reuters the USDC issuer plans to enter about 40 emerging and developing markets, citing rising demand in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East.

entry.title: Bitcoin Treasury Giant Strategy Faces Index Removal Under Finalized MSCI Rules
entry.summary: The index provider will classify “non-operating companies” as ineligible starting Nov. 30, targeting firms whose balance sheets are dominated by a single asset.

entry.title: India's Cyber Agency Says AI Agents Read Confidential Business Records Without Authorization
entry.summary: India's CERT-In says AI agents exceeded their assigned tasks in tests and read confidential records on live Indian systems.

entry.title: CFTC Wants to Drop Gemini’s $5M Settlement. A Judge Just Said No
entry.summary: The judge ruled that a shift in the CFTC’s enforcement priorities and misconduct allegations against its enforcement division weren’t enough to reopen a deal Gemini signed weeks before trial.

entry.title: Bitcoin Bounces, But Where Does It Go Next? Here’s What the Charts Say
entry.summary: Technical indicators suggest the bullish trend remains intact, but prediction market traders are sending mix signals.

entry.title: Three Canadian Armed Forces Members Charged in Kidnapping of Crypto Exchange Owner
entry.summary: Police seized guns, silencers and more than 2,000 rounds of ammunition, nearly all of it allegedly stolen from the Canadian military.

entry.title: Scammer Lost $4.8M in Bitcoin to Tampered Ledger Wallets: Chainalysis
entry.summary: The funds came from a task scam that paid people to fake product sales and reviews, then demanded deposits before releasing their pay.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Google Clears a Major Quantum Hurdle, Bitcoin Still Safe
entry.summary: Plus, crypto majors rebound despite hot PPI and Saylor’s Strategy is at risk of removal from a major index.

entry.title: OpenAI Model Used Testnet Ethereum Wallet Without Permission to Finish Coding Task
entry.summary: The internal model derived keys from public developer recovery phrases, spent another account's test ETH, and left it out of its report.

entry.title: GTA 6 Trailer Features Meme Coin—And Solana Copycat Soars 2,900%
entry.summary: Rockstar released the launch trailer for GTA VI, revealing a potential meme coin in the upcoming game and sending degens wild.

entry.title: What Is a Hardware Wallet? Crypto Cold Storage Explained
entry.summary: Hardware wallets keep your crypto keys offline. Learn how devices from Ledger, Trezor and others protect your Bitcoin and Ethereum.

entry.title: Hidden Text, a Fake Mailbox: How Researchers Got Rogue AI Agents to Talk
entry.summary: Researchers added hidden text to contact AI agents probing Alibaba’s map service, getting replies about their tasks as investigators traced activity to Tencent Cloud infrastructure.

entry.title: Google Says It Just Cracked One of Quantum Computing's Biggest Bottlenecks
entry.summary: Google's Willow chip cut errors 40x on the scarce “magic states” quantum computers burn through, a step toward smaller, useful machines—and toward ones that could threaten today's encryption.

entry.title: Russia Will Soon Ban Peer-to-Peer Bitcoin Trading, Central Bank Confirms
entry.summary: Russians have until July 1, 2027 to buy and sell crypto directly with each other. After that, every trade runs through a broker or exchange approved by the Bank of Russia.

entry.title: Boom or Bust, Bitcoin Wins the AI Trade, Bitwise CIO Says
entry.summary: In a note to investors, Matt Hougan used a “Choose Your Own Adventure” framework to argue that superabundance, an AI bust or a muddle-through economy all ultimately funnel to the same place: Bitcoin higher.

entry.title: BlackRock’s Larry Fink Warns AI Data Center Halt Could Tip US Into Recession
entry.summary: Speaking after BlackRock’s Q3 earnings, Fink said AI infrastructure spending has become so central to growth that a construction halt would be dangerous—calling the backlash “misinformation” as data centers become a midterm flashpoint.

entry.title: Google Says AI Isn't Building Itself Yet—Even Though It Writes 75% of the Code
entry.summary: Google DeepMind's first internal audit of AI-driven research finds no measurable speedup in AI progress.

entry.title: Mastercard and BVNK Launch 'Global Money Platform' to Merge Fiat and Stablecoins
entry.summary: The first major integration since Mastercard’s $1.8 billion BVNK acquisition lets banks, fintechs and enterprises hold, convert, and spend fiat and stablecoins through a single API, with agentic commerce support planned.

entry.title: Bitcoin Whipsaws as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion
entry.summary: Hot inflation data revived Fed rate-hike bets, and leveraged bulls paid the bill as nearly $1 billion in crypto positions were liquidated.

entry.title: Ethereum, Altcoins See 'Outsized Drawdowns' Due to Macro Pressures
entry.summary: Market analysts say that macro factors are pushing altcoin prices down, after ETH, XRP, and SOL all dropped on the day.

entry.title: Ledger Announces Atom Touchscreen Android Device
entry.summary: Ledger says the Android-based Atom will carry anti-tamper protections and be sold only on its site, as it probes tampered resold wallets.

entry.title: Zcash Tanks Double Digits After 'Meteoric Rise' Sees Leverage Build Up
entry.summary: Experts blame a build up in leverage for Zcash's drop in value, as well as growing concerns about AI breaking crypto encryption.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Solana Is About To Get Faster
entry.summary: Alpenglow is coming next week, slashing Solana finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of about 150 milliseconds—some 85 times faster.

entry.title: Bitcoin Tests $81,000 as Rate Hike Fears Linger After Hot Inflation Data
entry.summary: Odds of an October Fed hike have climbed to 29% from 18% a week ago, and analysts see Bitcoin range-bound until the picture clears.

entry.title: Brooklyn Prosecutors Take Down 112 Servers Behind Crypto Scam Targeting Russian Speakers
entry.summary: The scammers also ran a fake recovery service, contacting victims weeks later with promises to get their stolen crypto back.

entry.title: Godfather of AI and 400 Scientists Want AI Models Cut Off From the Internet
entry.summary: After a summer of AI models escaping test environments and hacking real companies, hundreds of researchers say the internet itself should be treated as a security boundary.

entry.title: Developer Who Cloned Photoshop With AI Just Did the Same to Microsoft Office
entry.summary: Developer Brandon Thomas used Anthropic's Claude to build free, open-source replicas of Word, Excel and PowerPoint. They're rough, but they show how cheap cloning software has become.

entry.title: AI Agents Made 138 Million Crypto Payments in a Year. Most Were Tiny
entry.summary: A new Chainalysis report found payments through Coinbase’s x402 protocol surged from about 1,500 in mid-2025 to more than 138 million by Q3 2026, with U.S. wallets dominating spending on AI models.

entry.title: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin
entry.summary: Sberbank now holds both custody and exchange status under Russia's new crypto law, and plans to bring Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT to apps used by 110 million retail clients.

entry.title: Solana Sets a Date for Its Next Major Upgrade
entry.summary: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade replaces the TowerBFT voting system on October 21, cutting finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of 150ms and pulling vote transactions out of blocks entirely.

entry.title: Standard Chartered Opens Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading to Wealthy UAE Clients
entry.summary: The British bank won Dubai regulatory approval to let affluent clients buy BTC and ETH straight from their bank accounts, with custody and settlement kept in-house.
